_readme: Ground-truth unique person counts for hand-carried camera clips. Put clip files in clips_dir (gitignored -- never committed, plan section 7). This file holds only numbers, so it IS committed and acts as the regression baseline for Phase 5 (mobile). Count each clip by eye and fill 'unique_count'. Tag each clip split=tune (used while tuning) or split=holdout (NEVER touched during tuning -- guards against overfitting, risk R5). Every clip MUST be filmed hand-carried/walking (plan section 1.5).
